name: pomodoro-windows
title: Pomodoro for Windows
description: A full Pomodoro timer for Raycast on Windows: customizable focus presets, type-a-task-and-go, Windows notifications plus Raycast HUDs, auto-start, daily goals and stats.
author: hridey_kapoor

commands.name: pomodoro
commands.title: Pomodoro
commands.description: Start a focus session by typing your task and pressing Enter. Manage focus presets, control the running timer, and see today's stats.

commands.name: quick-toggle
commands.title: Pomodoro Quick Toggle
commands.subtitle: Pomodoro
commands.description: One hotkey that does the next obvious thing: start focus with your default preset, pause, resume, or start the next interval. Also keeps the timer running and shows time left here in root search.

preferences.name: dailyGoal
preferences.title: Daily Goal
preferences.description: How many focus intervals you aim for each day.

preferences.name: autoStartBreaks
preferences.title: Automation
preferences.label: Auto-start breaks after focus
preferences.description: Start the break automatically when a focus interval ends.

preferences.name: autoStartFocus
preferences.label: Auto-start focus after breaks
preferences.description: Start the next focus interval automatically when a break ends.

preferences.name: enableToast
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.label: Show Windows notification
preferences.description: Show a native Windows toast notification when an interval ends.

preferences.name: enableSound
preferences.label: Play alarm sound
preferences.description: Play a sound when an interval ends.

preferences.name: sound
preferences.title: Alarm Sound
preferences.description: Built-in Windows sound to play when an interval ends.

preferences.name: customSound
preferences.title: Custom Sound (.wav)
preferences.description: Optional .wav file to play instead of the built-in sound.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
